Unicode Inspector

Inspect any text character by character: code point, UTF-16 units, UTF-8 bytes, Unicode block and category — handles emoji and surrogate pairs correctly.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste text into the input box.
  2. Each character is broken down into code point, UTF-8 bytes and more.
  3. Use it to debug invisible characters, emoji and encodings.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

Type or paste any text. Each Unicode code point gets a row: the character, U+XXXX, UTF-16 code units, UTF-8 bytes, block and category.

Does it handle emoji correctly?

Yes — it iterates by code point (not UTF-16 unit), so emoji like 😀 show as a single U+1F600 with its 4 UTF-8 bytes.

Are the UTF-8 bytes real?

UTF-8 bytes are computed with the real encoding algorithm from the code point, and blocks come from the official Unicode range table.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
